evidence:
REACHABILITY (good): every capability is reachable. The agent image (environment/Dockerfile:1-12) gives Node 22, Express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1 and public network (task.toml:22), so a parser/formatter can be bundled; integration.md:3-11 matches the launcher (tests/test.sh:97-111: node server.js, port 3000, DB_PATH, uid 65534, symlink rule at test.sh:72-83). instruction.md:3 says 'six notes' and six files exist. Isolation, dynamic-code refusal, five-second budget (loop guard or isolated frame), last-good restore and line numbers are all buildable with a sandboxed iframe plus CSP, as the golden shows (solution/app/src/runtime.ts:7, 376-387). No requirement depends on a missing seed, private service or unpinned tool.

AMBIGUITIES (more than one reasonable reading):
(A) ui.md:9 'Allow Alt+Click or Ctrl/Cmd+Click to add carets'. 'or' reads either as the builder's choice of one gesture (policy.md:3 leaves choices to the builder) or as both required. Three criteria repeat the same 'or' as the judge's choice: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:101, :110 ('real modifier-clicks'), :119 (combined weight 5.5 of the functional dimension). The golden accepts all three modifiers (solution/app/src/custom-editor.js:356), which hides the problem.
(B) behaviour.md:13 'If the same restore request is sent again after it was already committed, for example after a lost reply, it must not create another revision.' The brief does not define what makes a request 'the same' and does not require any visible way to resend it, while the same paragraph says a restore 'creates a new current revision'. The criterion at functional/judge.toml:353 needs 'the control the app offers for retrying it, or ... replaying the recorded request'; app_context.md:23 simultaneously says clearing storage is 'the one permitted use of script to change browser state'. The golden ships a 'Retry same restore' button (solution/app/src/app.tsx:160) that the brief never asks for.
(C) behaviour.md:3 requires a one-based line number for 'a Promise rejection that nothing handles; the message is the text of the Error or rejected value'. For a rejected non-Error value the browser's unhandledrejection event carries no location, so a line number is not generally reachable; the criterion (functional/judge.toml:236) only uses Error objects, so this is latent.
(D) behaviour.md:5 'pending timer or Promise callbacks until that run settles' does not define settling for a never-resolved promise, native await or requestAnimationFrame loops; criteria exercise only timers and source loops, so latent.
(E) ui.md:9 'normal keyboard shortcuts' for Redo does not say Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z or both; criteria say 'the usual keyboard shortcut' (functional/judge.toml:74, :155). Golden handles both ('y' and 'z' at custom-editor.js:290-296). Latent, same shape as (A).

No configured judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index.json scope: scripted golden only), so the effect on a real judge is not measured.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that can fail, (A): an app that implements multi-caret with Ctrl/Cmd+Click only, a fair reading of 'Alt+Click or Ctrl/Cmd+Click'. A judge that follows the criterion text and uses Alt+Click sees a single caret and fails cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic, cw_multi_caret_delete and cw_same_line_carets although the editor is correct. Conforming alternative that can fail, (B): an app that makes restore idempotent with a client operation id and resends automatically after a lost reply, but shows no retry button. The judge has no sanctioned way to resend the committed request; pressing Restore on revision one again is a new request that correctly creates revision five under behaviour.md:13, and cw_history_restore_retry is failed for 'the repeated request adds a revision'.
suggested_fix: ui.md:9: state one reading, e.g. 'Both Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click add a caret', or change the three criteria to 'try Alt+Click and, if no caret appears, Ctrl/Cmd+Click; either one working is enough'. behaviour.md:13: say how a retry is observable, e.g. 'after a restore, offer a way to send that same restore again; using it must not create another revision', and align functional/judge.toml:353 and app_context.md:23 to that single route. Optionally limit the line-number sentence in behaviour.md:3 to rejected Error objects and name both Redo shortcuts (or accept either in the criteria).
